module: Flowgraph node "Rally Mode Session Start" (category once_instant, tag rally). Loads what rally mode needs: extensions gameplay_rally, rally loop bridge (extRallyLoop) and gameplay_rallyStartClock; determines the mission (via the rally loop manager if loaded, otherwise RallyUtil.detectMissionIdHelper); calls gameplay_rally.loadMission(missionId, missionDir, nil, voicepackPick, {owner = 'mission'}); if disableOnStart, disables pacenote processing; in loop mode, calls gameplay_rallyLoop.setupForNewMission() and outputs the loop prefab path (loopPrefab, rm:getLoopPrefabPath()). If fireEvents, triggers the onRallySessionStart hook. Inputs: fireEvents (default true), disableOnStart (default false). Output: loopPrefab (string).
notes: When the graph stops, unloads gameplay_rallyStartClock and gameplay_rally (and the loop bridge if it was loaded by this node and no loop manager exists) then triggers onRallySessionEnd if fireEvents.
If the mission is not detected, an error box is logged and nothing is loaded.
The loopPrefab pin is declared with type string and default = false (inconsistent).

_executionStopped.desc: Unloads the rally extensions and emits onRallySessionEnd if fireEvents.

unloadExt.desc: Unloads gameplay_rallyStartClock, gameplay_rally and, under conditions, the rally loop bridge.

loadExt.desc: Loads the gameplay_rally extension if needed.

loadRallyLoopBridge.desc: Loads the rally loop bridge if it is not loaded and remembers whether this node loaded it.

workOnce.desc: Executes the session start sequence described in the module description.
